as_told.title: Atomic Energy Commission records concluding UFOs are extraterrestrial, possibly tied to AFSWP crash records

plain: Old records from the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that ran nuclear weapons work after the Second World War, are said to have concluded that UFOs are "extraterrestrial vehicles", and to have been kept by the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a Pentagon agency that deals with weapons of mass destruction. A UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this on Michels' show in 2026, repeating what a man named Dylan Borland said on another podcast, Weaponized. In a second pass UAPGerb drops the agency as the keeper and suggests the records may link instead to crash records from the Armed Forces Special Weapons Project, the military's early nuclear weapons unit, and to the Sandia nuclear laboratory.
